description: Wikimedia Commons image search (MediaWiki API, public, no key): file title, direct image URL, size, MIME type, license, author and description for free-licensed files. Returns file metadata only, not image bytes. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

title: Search Wikimedia Commons Image
